function.name: spaceman_scene
function.description: List available satellites/arms, plan a selected or seeded-random combination, or safely render one fixed inspection scene in Genesis. No training or grasp execution. Calls must run serially. Read list_assets before choosing IDs. Omit IDs for seeded-random selection; changing topology builds a new scene.

carrier.description: Carrier satellite ID; omit for random selection

arm.description: Registered arm ID; omit for random selection

target.description: Target satellite ID; omit for random selection

run_id.description: Required unique output ID for render_scene; do not reuse
